pondeR: Making Statistical Analysis a Little Bit Easier

Source: R/pondeR-package.R
pondeR-package.Rd

Generate publication-ready statistical tables and figures with minimal code. Provides descriptive summary tables, automatic selection of group-difference and association tests with effect sizes and post hoc comparisons, correlation analysis, receiver operating characteristic curves, logistic regression with optional Firth correction (Firth, 1993) doi:10.1093/biomet/80.1.27 , penalized regression (Friedman, Hastie and Tibshirani, 2010) doi:10.18637/jss.v033.i01 , linear mixed-effects models (Bates et al., 2015) doi:10.18637/jss.v067.i01 , principal component and principal coordinate analysis with permutational multivariate analysis of variance (Anderson, 2001) doi:10.1111/j.1442-9993.2001.01070.pp.x , partial least squares, linear discriminant analysis effect size (Segata et al., 2011) doi:10.1186/gb-2011-12-6-r60 , content validity indices (Lawshe, 1975) doi:10.1111/j.1744-6570.1975.tb01393.x , World Health Organization child growth z-scores, and plotting helpers for volcano, score, scree, heatmap, dendrogram, odds-ratio and relative-abundance plots.
